name: Micron Xi'an assembly and test expansion
summary: An expansion of Micron's packaging and test site in Xi'an, China, announced in June 2023 with a 4.3 billion yuan budget. The plan adds a new building with a production line for mobile DRAM, NAND and SSD products and takes over the assets of a contractor that had run lines in the factory. Ground was broken in March 2024 and the main structure topped out in November 2024; production was targeted for the second half of 2025, but no source found reports that it began.

metrics.note: Spread over several years; includes the new building, new equipment and the acquired assets.
Additional jobs, on top of about 1,200 contractor employees offered Micron contracts.

milestones.note: Topping-out of the new building's main structure.
Target given at the March 2024 groundbreaking; the date has passed and no source found confirms that production in the new building has started.

notes: The contractor whose assets Micron acquired is Powercheng Semiconductor (Xi'an). The newest source found is the November 2024 report of the new building's topping-out; a search of Micron releases, filings and Chinese press in November 2026 found no report that production in the new building has begun, so the status stays under construction as of that report.
